clusters.name: Monitoring Signal Selection
clusters.description: Varies which reward, behavioral, internal, and operational signals monitoring exposes from deployed agents.

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Signal Selection affect the outcomes of Detection Analytics
relations.rationale: Available reward, behavioral, reasoning, and dashboard signals determine which detection analyses can be implemented.

values.label: External reward-only monitoring
values.description: Observes externally visible rewards without requiring instrumentation inside the deployed agent.

values.label: Behavioral inspection
values.description: Combines reward observation with inspection of actual actions, robustness, and specification-conforming behavior.

values.label: Scratchpad reasoning observability
values.description: Exposes and analyzes reasoning traces for evaluation awareness, hidden strategies, or specification gaming.

values.label: Process-supervised reward
values.description: Rewards intermediate reasoning or verified steps in addition to final outcomes.

values.label: Hybrid outcome-process monitoring signals
values.description: Monitoring that combines outcome-level and process-level signals to expose superficial or spurious exploitation.

values.label: Intervention-rate monitoring
values.description: Monitors how frequently runtime safety controls intervene, especially on unfamiliar states.

values.label: RL-specific metric monitoring
values.description: Exposes reward, exploration, entropy, and learning-progress signals for deployed RL operations.

clusters.name: Operational Monitoring Presentation
clusters.description: Varies how monitoring information is presented for day-to-day operational use and investigation.

values.label: Operational monitoring dashboards
values.description: Provides leadership-facing dashboards for visibility into deployed-system status and compliance.

clusters.name: Evaluation Coverage Strategy
clusters.description: Varies which objectives, contexts, environments, tasks, and difficulty levels are included when testing deployed-agent behavior.

values.label: Held-out deployment-environment evaluation
values.description: Tests behavior in environments or features withheld from training to expose deployment-specific failures.

values.label: Diverse behavioral evaluation
values.description: Evaluates a broad range of behaviors to distinguish useful novelty from reward gaming.

values.label: Escalating gameability curriculum
values.description: Uses progressively more difficult and gameable environments to expose increasingly capable exploits.

values.label: Expanded exploit evaluation suite
values.description: Broadens tests after an exploit to detect unrelated or future reward-hacking strategies.

values.label: Context-specific evaluation benchmarks
values.description: Evaluates deployed behavior against domain, context, or industry-specific benchmarks aligned with operational requirements.

clusters.name: Evaluation and Verification Mechanism
clusters.description: Varies the tests, verifiers, baselines, simulations, rubrics, and evaluators used to establish whether deployed-agent behavior is valid.

values.label: Reward-hacking verification
values.description: Determines whether behavior is genuinely exploitative or an unexpected but valid strategy before remediation.

values.label: Hint-assisted faithfulness evaluation
values.description: Tests whether agents disclose injected information and remain faithful across correct, incorrect, and multiple-channel hints.

values.label: Reference-baseline output comparison
values.description: Compares agent outputs with a trusted baseline to validate correctness before scoring performance.

values.label: Multi-layered evaluation stack
values.description: Combines automated metrics, domain benchmarks, model judges, and human checkpoints for robust evaluation.

clusters.name: Detection Analytics
clusters.description: Varies statistical tests, classifiers, anomaly indicators, and baselines used to detect degradation, reward hacking, instability, or unusual behavior.

relations.reading: Choices on Detection Analytics affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: Detection sensitivity and false-positive behavior determine when operators classify behavior as an exploit and initiate remediation.

values.label: Robust anomaly detection
values.description: Detects unexpected behavioral changes and reward-hacking anomalies under changing agent capabilities.

values.label: Reward-hack detection classifier
values.description: Uses classifiers to identify reward-hacking behavior in production traces or outputs.

values.label: Proxy-metric reward objective
values.description: Uses measurable proxy metrics as operational stand-ins for complex intended objectives.

values.label: Real-time drift alerting
values.description: Automated alerts that expose distribution or performance drift for rapid operational response.

values.label: Metric-divergence alerting
values.description: Alerts triggered when an optimized metric improves while related quality or safety metrics worsen.

clusters.name: Human Review Protocol
clusters.description: Varies the consistency, expertise, and resource arrangements used for human review of agent behavior.

values.label: Representative expert review with production monitoring
values.description: A structured review protocol using qualified evaluators and representative coverage, supplemented by direct inspection of deployed agent behavior at production scale.

includes.label: Structured expert review protocol
includes.description: Standardized review by qualified human evaluators using consistent feedback procedures.

includes.label: Representative annotation coverage
includes.description: Human review and annotation samples represent the relevant range of enterprise perspectives and deployment situations.

includes.label: Manual monitoring at production scale
includes.description: Relies on humans to inspect deployed agent actions directly despite limited scalability.

clusters.name: Safety-Control Application
clusters.description: Varies runtime and training-time controls that constrain, filter, shield, block, or inoculate deployed-agent actions and inputs.

relations.reading: Choices on Safety-Control Application affect the outcomes of Exploit Remediation Actions
relations.rationale: The batch shows retraining, continued learning, and rollback sequencing changing post-incident remediation outcomes.

values.label: Anti-hacking constraint layer
values.description: Adds an explicit constraint layer to block reward hacks beyond reward-function revisions.

values.label: Adversarial training as sole mitigation
values.description: Treats adversarial reward-model training as sufficient protection against future reward exploits.

values.label: Input and output safety filtering
values.description: Filters harmful inputs and outputs as a preventive safety layer around deployed agents.

values.label: Real-time guardrail layer
values.description: Applies runtime controls that prevent deployed systems from crossing compliance or ethical boundaries.

clusters.name: Deployed-Policy Updating
clusters.description: Varies when and how deployed policies adapt, retrain, restore, or incorporate feedback in response to monitoring and changing conditions.

values.label: Mid-run intervention
values.description: Interrupts or alters an agent run when reward hacking or unsafe behavior is detected.

values.label: Continuous policy adaptation
values.description: Continuously incorporates operational feedback and new conditions into deployed-agent learning or updates.

values.label: Scheduled incremental fine-tuning
values.description: Updates deployed policies in recurring nightly or weekly jobs using recent data and small training increments.

values.label: Continuous online policy updating
values.description: Updates policy parameters or adapters continuously from streaming or immediate feedback, including micro-batch updates.

values.label: Rolling parameter-efficient fine-tuning
values.description: Uses frequent PEFT updates to keep production policies current while reducing the cost and delay of full retraining.

values.label: Immediate user-feedback updating
values.description: Uses accepted, rejected, or corrected user interactions to update the deployed policy rapidly.

values.label: Metric-triggered retraining
values.description: Updates the agent when monitored metrics or drift signals breach predefined thresholds.

values.label: Evaluation-distribution-matched adaptation prompts
values.description: Policy adaptation uses prompts resembling evaluations and deployment-context value judgments to target known alignment risks.

clusters.name: Reward and Training Mitigation
clusters.description: Varies objective shaping, regularization, adversarial training, and optimization-pressure choices used to mitigate unsafe or hacked agent behavior.

values.label: Monitor-guided regularized learning
values.description: Combines reward regularization with monitor feedback and policy-model regularization so that detected unsafe behavior influences training incentives and policy updates.

includes.label: Reward regularization
includes.description: Constrains reward optimization to reduce exploitation of loopholes in the reward function.

includes.label: Monitor-based reward shaping
includes.description: Uses monitor feedback to shape training incentives and discourage reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Model regularization for offline policies
includes.description: Regularizes conservative or offline policy learning to reduce unsafe extrapolation and instability.

values.label: Comprehensive computational mitigation
values.description: Uses an expensive, multi-layer mitigation pipeline combining reward and monitor shaping, offline-policy regularization, conservative objectives, adversarial training, reasoning-trace pressure, and strong optimization pressure.

includes.label: Reward regularization
includes.description: Constrains reward optimization to reduce exploitation of loopholes in the reward function.

includes.label: Monitor-based reward shaping
includes.description: Uses monitor feedback to shape training incentives and discourage reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Model regularization for offline policies
includes.description: Regularizes conservative or offline policy learning to reduce unsafe extrapolation and instability.

includes.label: Conservative offline-RL objective
includes.description: Uses conservative learning targets to limit overfitting and unsafe policy development from historical logs.

includes.label: Adversarial training
includes.description: Uses adversarial examples or interactions to expose and reduce reward-hacking behavior.

includes.label: Chain-of-thought reward pressure
includes.description: Uses monitor-detected reasoning content to apply training-time reward pressure against undesirable behavior.

includes.label: Strong chain-of-thought optimization pressure
includes.description: Applies strong optimization pressure to monitored reasoning traces to suppress undesirable thoughts.

includes.label: Computationally intensive mitigation
includes.description: Uses expensive computation as part of deployed-agent reward-hacking mitigation.

values.label: Adversarial monitor-guided shaping
values.description: Uses adversarial examples or interactions together with monitor feedback and reward shaping to expose and suppress reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Reward regularization
includes.description: Constrains reward optimization to reduce exploitation of loopholes in the reward function.

includes.label: Monitor-based reward shaping
includes.description: Uses monitor feedback to shape training incentives and discourage reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Adversarial training
includes.description: Uses adversarial examples or interactions to expose and reduce reward-hacking behavior.

values.label: Adversarial conservative offline mitigation
values.description: Combines monitor-guided reward shaping and adversarial training with conservative, regularized policy learning to reduce the transfer of hacking behaviors into unfamiliar settings.

includes.label: Monitor-based reward shaping
includes.description: Uses monitor feedback to shape training incentives and discourage reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Model regularization for offline policies
includes.description: Regularizes conservative or offline policy learning to reduce unsafe extrapolation and instability.

includes.label: Conservative offline-RL objective
includes.description: Uses conservative learning targets to limit overfitting and unsafe policy development from historical logs.

includes.label: Adversarial training
includes.description: Uses adversarial examples or interactions to expose and reduce reward-hacking behavior.

values.label: Reasoning-trace optimization pressure
values.description: Uses monitored chain-of-thought or reasoning content to apply reward pressure, including strong optimization pressure, against undesirable reasoning and behavior.

includes.label: Monitor-based reward shaping
includes.description: Uses monitor feedback to shape training incentives and discourage reward-hacking strategies.

includes.label: Chain-of-thought reward pressure
includes.description: Uses monitor-detected reasoning content to apply training-time reward pressure against undesirable behavior.

includes.label: Strong chain-of-thought optimization pressure
includes.description: Applies strong optimization pressure to monitored reasoning traces to suppress undesirable thoughts.

clusters.name: Unknown-Situation Detection
clusters.description: Varies deployment assumptions and mechanisms for detecting distribution shift and unfamiliar situations.

relations.reading: Choices on Unknown-Situation Detection affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Open-world handling, tool use, and hidden-regime inference determine which deployment and out-of-distribution tests are necessary.

values.label: Unknown-situation detection
values.description: Detects unfamiliar conditions instead of producing confident decisions without recognizing uncertainty.

clusters.name: Exploit Remediation Actions
clusters.description: Varies post-detection reward revision, exploit patching, and the resulting residual or future coverage risks.

relations.reading: Choices on Exploit Remediation Actions affect the outcomes of Evaluation Coverage Strategy
relations.rationale: Known exploits motivate broader evaluation suites and new tests for future, cross-context, and cross-environment failures.

values.label: Automated policy rollback
values.description: Restores a previously stable policy or checkpoint when monitoring detects a production regression or severe incident. This is a recovery-oriented remediation strategy rather than a reward-function change.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

values.label: Iterative reward-function patching with rollback
values.description: Uses exploit-specific reward revision and repeated adversarial patching to improve objective alignment, with policy rollback available as part of the remediation loop. This supports continuing mitigation of known exploits and recovery from regressions.

includes.label: Exploit-specific reward revision
includes.description: Revises the reward function to close an identified loophole and restore objective alignment.

includes.label: Iterative adversarial exploit patching
includes.description: Applies targeted patches to known reward-hacking exploits as part of a continuing mitigation process.

includes.label: Automated policy rollback
includes.description: Restores a prior stable policy or checkpoint after a detected production regression or severe incident.

clusters.name: Release Validation Strategy
clusters.description: Varies how policy changes are validated and exposed before or during production release.

values.label: Evaluation-gated release
values.description: Releases an updated policy only after it passes predefined evaluation checks.

clusters.name: Monitoring Feedback Channel
clusters.description: Varies which human or automated evaluators provide feedback for monitoring and adaptation.

values.label: Human-preference reward model
values.description: Uses human rankings or labels to estimate response quality and guide optimization.

values.label: AI-feedback reward signal
values.description: Uses a capable AI evaluator to generate scalable feedback for aligning deployed-agent behavior when human annotation is costly.

values.label: Decoupled approval feedback
values.description: Collects approval feedback independently and before action execution so agents cannot corrupt the reward signal through their world actions.

values.label: LLM-based evaluator feedback
values.description: Uses language models as graders that supply feedback or rewards for difficult-to-verify outputs.

clusters.name: Monitoring Telemetry Verification
clusters.description: Varies how monitoring telemetry is collected, checked, and verified beyond selecting signal content.

values.label: Behavioral anomaly detection
values.description: Uses indicators of implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior to detect failures and alignment or reward-hacking risks.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

values.label: Integrated trajectory observability and evidence storage
values.description: Combines operational and behavioral monitoring with verified trajectories, metadata, and action outcomes stored for diagnosis, offline learning, and production verification.

includes.label: Operational telemetry monitoring
includes.description: Exposes latency, resource, drift, error, traffic, and safety signals appropriate to each deployed policy context.

includes.label: Behavioral anomaly indicators
includes.description: Flags implausible, fragile, specification-literal, or otherwise unusual agent behavior.

includes.label: Trajectory telemetry verification
includes.description: Inventories logs and verifies required trajectory fields before relying on them for monitoring or offline learning.

includes.label: Trajectory and metadata data lake
includes.description: Stores complete trajectories and associated metadata for later monitoring, diagnosis, and verification.

includes.label: Action outcome logging
includes.description: Captures action outcome codes needed to calculate failure rates and verify production behavior.

clusters.name: Compliance and Audit Review
clusters.description: Varies how external accountability, compliance evidence, and independent review are conducted.

values.label: Reward-hacking case documentation
values.description: Uses focused records of suspected reward-hacking behavior to support diagnosis, reproducibility, and improvement of future monitoring.

includes.label: Reward-hacking behavior documentation
includes.description: Documents suspected exploit behavior for diagnosis, reproducibility, and future monitoring improvement.

clusters.name: Monitoring Reproducibility Artifacts
clusters.description: Varies how datasets, experiments, policies, and monitoring artifacts are versioned for reproducibility.

values.label: Insight-informed monitoring-data design
values.description: Versions and structures monitoring or training data around empirically observed reward behavior and exploitation risks, without necessarily maintaining full policy or dataset lineage.

includes.label: Insight-informed data design
includes.description: Designs monitoring and training data using empirical understanding of reward exploitation.

clusters.name: Monitoring Operations Governance
clusters.description: Varies ownership, maintenance coordination, and incident-response responsibilities for monitoring infrastructure.

values.label: Cross-team maintenance workflow
values.description: Coordinates monitoring upkeep and escalation across teams responsible for models, infrastructure, and operations.

clusters.name: RL Deployment Architecture
clusters.description: Varies the computational and organizational architecture used to train or operate distributed reinforcement-learning agents.

values.label: Custom RL pipeline development
values.description: Builds a bespoke RL pipeline when frameworks cannot meet integration, safety, or performance requirements.

values.label: Cloud-native RL service adoption
values.description: Uses managed cloud services for RL training, deployment, and monitoring.

values.label: Distributed multi-GPU and multi-node training
values.description: Scales RL experiments across multiple GPUs and nodes while targeting stability and reproducibility.

values.label: Production RL framework selection
values.description: Selects a production RL framework based on scalability, integration, and operational requirements.
